projects.notes: The reactors are installed at McIntosh, and the GPC rebuild is only 0.1 mi at the McIntosh end. Purrysburg is on the SC side. SERTP 2014 p.45 (sertp-2014-plan, excerpt verified) calls it 'Purrysburg (SCPSA)', so it is a Santee Cooper substation, not a DESC one. The DESC Jasper Generating Plant switchyard (OSM way/185380597, 'Jasper Substation', 230 kV generation) is about 0.9 km south and is a different facility.

It does not end at the DESC Jasper generating switchyard (way/185380597). A 230 kV line also leaves this substation toward the Bluffton area (way/185381110, 19.6 mi), which fits a Santee Cooper (SCPSA) station, as SERTP 2014 p.45 says. I confirmed with Nominatim that Purrysburg Road (way/12420907) is next to it. The researcher's EIPC 4.79 mi circuit length is not in the cache, so I could not re-verify it. The identification does not depend on it.

projects.notes: This is a new 500/230 kV substation, and OSM does not have it yet (re-checked Overpass extract bigog.json). SERTP 2025 p.75 says it is 'near Little Ogeechee substation'. The Georgia Power article (gpc-big-ogeechee-news-2026) places it in west Chatham County along an existing high-voltage line, with a new line nearly five miles down Little Neck Road. WTOC (2025-02-27, https://www.wtoc.com/2025/02/27/residents-little-neck-rd-concerned-about-upcoming-georgia-power-project/) says the line runs from an existing substation on Little Neck Road to 'a new one on Bush Road'. STATUS FLAG: a 2026-07-24 syndicated news report (https://www.aol.com/articles/georgia-power-substation-set-power-090526000.html) says the substation began moving energy in early July 2026. It may already be complete at the snapshot date, so eligibility should be reviewed. This source is not cached.

endpoints.validation: The plan says the site is next to the shared 500 kV/230 kV right of way and near Little Ogeechee. WTOC says it is on Bush Road. Bush Road crosses the shared right of way only once, at this point, 5.8 km from Little Ogeechee, which fits the 'nearly five miles' Little Neck Road line. The plan's 'McCall Road - Thalmann 500kV' is tagged 'Thalmann - Blandford 500kV' in OSM, and it is the only 500 kV line on this right of way. The fenced site is not mapped, so this is an estimate: locality, lower confidence.
